_comment: customer.* comes from assets/brand.json — copy pageImage verbatim, the capture writes
page.jpg by default. ava.channel is load-bearing: it drives the transcript's channel line,
the page header and the widget defaults, so a voice AVA is never called web chat. Set it to
'voice', 'chat' or 'messaging'. Omit the whole widget block to accept the channel's defaults.
Omit disclaimer unless the default wording doesn't fit the data this demo shows.
disclaimer: Recorded against the published AVA using mock Data Actions. Every member ID, plan and
balance in this conversation is demonstration data, not a live customer record.

useCases.title: Check plan benefits
useCases.summary: Member authenticates and asks what their plan covers.

messages.text: Hi! I'm the Acme Member Assistant. I can help with benefits, claims and finding a dentist. What can I do for you?
I want to know if a crown is covered on my plan.
Happy to check that. Can I start with your member ID?
Thanks! You're on the PPO Plus plan. Crowns are covered at 50% after your deductible, and you have $1,240 left on your annual maximum.
